THE RELIGIOUS EDUCATION COUNCIL OF THE PROVINCE OF QUEBEC, YEAR BY YEAR
Officers as printed in the International Council of Religious Education's
yearbooks, read 2026-09-07 from two BOUND-RUN volumes on the Internet Archive.

=====================================================================
WHY THIS RE-READ HAPPENED, AND WHAT IT CORRECTS
=====================================================================

On 2026-09-06 this project downloaded five of these yearbooks, scanned them
for "Harold C. Cross", read the officer block around each hit, and concluded
that he was "in that body's leadership from at least 1933 to at least 1945" --
"a twelve-year office" where the article had previously seen a ten-year hole.

TWO OF THE ITEMS ARE NOT SINGLE YEARBOOKS. They are bound runs of six and four
years each, and the earlier pass found the name where it occurred without
establishing which bound year each occurrence sat in. One item's title page
says 1933, and the Cross listing inside it was taken for 1933. IT IS NOT.

  yearbook0000inte_t6c3  binds SIX yearbooks: 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938
  yearbook0000inte_y7m7  binds FOUR:          1939, 1940, 1941, 1942
      (this is the volume the earlier pass registered, deliberately, as
       src_icre_yearbook_undated because it could find no year on it. Its
       running heads carry all four.)

Each Quebec block below is placed by the dated year-marks that bracket it in
the same text, and the sequence is monotonic across all ten blocks.

=====================================================================
THE PRESIDENCY, 1933-1938  (from t6c3)
=====================================================================

1933  President--SYDNEY COMBER, 4206 Old Orchard Ave., N.D.G., Montreal
      Vice-President--Arthur Webster, 521 Victoria Ave., Westmount
      Secretary--James A. Reid, 5331 Queen Mary Rd., Montreal
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 4307 Montrose Ave., Westmount

1934  President--SYDNEY COMBER, 4206 Old Orchard Ave., N.D.G., Montreal
      Vice-President--Arthur Webster, 521 Victoria Ave., Westmount
      Secretary--James A. Reid, 18 Milroy Ave., Valois
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 1481 Fort St., Montreal

1935  President--HAROLD C. CROSS, Y. M. C. A., Drummond St., Montreal
      Vice-President--James J. Reid, 18 Milroy Ave., Valois, P.Q.
      Secretary--Milly Brisbane, 452 Strathcona Ave., Westmount
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal

1936  President--HAROLD C. CROSS, 1441 Drummond St., Montreal
      Vice-President--Rev. A. M. Hill, Ph.D., 297 Beatty Ave., Verdun, Que.
      Secretary--James A. Reid, 19 Mt. Pleasant Ave., Valois, Que.
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal

1937  President--DR. A. M. HILL, 297 Beatty Ave., Verdun, Que.
      Secretary--James A. Reid, 19 Mt. Pleasant Ave., Valois, Que.
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal
      General Secretary--Rev. David I. Forsyth

1938  President--DR. A. M. HILL, 299 Beatty Ave., Verdun
      Secretary--Gordon K. Hedges, 640 Moffat Ave., Verdun
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal
      General Secretary--(Vacant)
      Secretary of Girls' Work--Nina A. Yeomans
      Secretary of Boys' Work--C. Don Burton

SO THE PRESIDENCY IS 1935 AND 1936, NOT 1933 AND 1936. In 1933 and 1934 the
president was Sydney Comber. And Cross was succeeded by his own
vice-president: A. M. Hill sits under him in 1936 and holds the chair in 1937
and 1938.

=====================================================================
THE GAP, 1939-1941, AND IT IS CONTROLLED  (from y7m7)
=====================================================================

1939  Quebec block present. NO CROSS.
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal
      Secretary of Girls' Work--Nina A. Yeomans
      Secretary of Boys' Work--C. Don Burton
      Honorary Secretary of Children's Work--Janet M. Doxsey

1940  Quebec block present. NO CROSS.
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal

1941  Quebec block present. NO CROSS.
      Honorary Treasurer--J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St. W., Montreal
      General Secretary--(Vacant)
      Secretary of Girls' Work--Nina A. Yeomans
      Secretary of Boys' Work--C. Don Burton

1942  President--Rev. E. Leslie Pidgeon, 3407 Ontario Ave., Montreal
      Recording Secretary--Miss Jean Ferguson
      CORRESPONDING SECRETARY--MR. HAROLD C. CROSS
      Honorary Treasurer--Mr. J. P. Copland, 389 St. Paul St., Montreal
      General Secretary--Vacant
      Council address: 406-07 Coronation Bldg., Montreal

THE NULL IS CONTROLLED BY J. P. COPLAND, who is Honorary Treasurer in every
one of the ten blocks above, 1933 through 1942, at four successive addresses.
If the Quebec block were being missed or garbled in 1939-41 he would be
missing too. He is not. Cross is simply not among the officers in those years.

=====================================================================
WHAT THE CAREER ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE
=====================================================================

  1935-1936   President
  1937-1941   not an officer
  1942-1945   Corresponding Secretary
              (1943 and 1945 from the separate single-year items already read
              here: under President Dr. E. Leslie Pidgeon in 1943 and Rev.
              Roland Bodger in 1945, Cross at Central Y.M.C.A., 1441 Drummond)

TWO SPELLS WITH A FIVE-YEAR GAP, not a continuous twelve-year office. The gap
is worth something on its own: he leaves the chair in 1937, in the years the
Year Book has him as a Montreal branch secretary, and comes back in 1942 in
the junior post, in the years he was also Acting General Secretary of the
association while Beaton was at the war.

NO OCCURRENCE OF "KANAWANA" IN ANY OF THE TEN YEARBOOKS. Checked in all six
bound years of t6c3, all four of y7m7, and the separate 1942, 1943 and 1945
items. This matches what the 2026-09-06 read found for 1936 and extends it.
